entities.name: Ján Bahýľ
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ján Bahýľ was a Slovak inventor and engineer. He specialised in military science, military construction, and engineering. Flying machines were a particular interest of his. In 1895, he was granted a patent on the helicopter.
